This is an unofficial fork of Sofa TV Browser, with extra features from TVCouchBrowser: the phone remote and trackpad, Clean up page, Remove element and extra filter lists. It is not made or supported by Sofa's developer.

Fork: github.com/crash101g/sofa-tv-browser
Original Sofa: github.com/sonalder-darlene/sofa-tv-browser
Clean up this site automatically: off
Clean up this site automatically: on
This site is cleaned up every time it loads
This site is no longer cleaned up automatically
Point at what to remove, then press OK. Back cancels.
Press OK to remove what has focus. Back cancels.
Removed, also next time. Clean up → Bring back undoes it.
Use your phone as a remote

Scan this with your phone's camera. A page opens where you can open websites, type into the TV, use a trackpad and a remote. Nothing to install.

The phone must be on the same Wi-Fi, and it works while Sofa is open. It is plain HTTP on your home network: don't send passwords through it on a network you don't trust.

Address for a “Send to TV” shortcut:
%1$s
Paired phones forgotten; the phone page is off until you pair again
Select a text box on the TV first

Adds uBlock Origin\'s own lists (ads, privacy, badware, quick fixes, unbreak), AdGuard Popups and Peter Lowe\'s list. They block mostly whole servers, so they cost little memory each; downloaded from their publishers when switched on.
